description: Rename a sheet in a session's workbook, found by its 0-based index (see the sheets list from create_session or inspect_model). Formulas, named ranges and validations that reference the sheet are rewritten to the new name, so results don't change; use it rather than add_sheet when you only need a different title. Excel's rules apply: 1-31 characters, none of : \ / ? * [ ], no leading or trailing apostrophe, unique ignoring case; a name that breaks them, or an index past the last sheet, fails with bad_request. Returns {sheet_index, previous_name, sheet_name}.

name.description: New display name for the sheet

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

sheet_index.description: 0-based index of the sheet to rename

name: rename_sheet
title: Rename sheet
